title: House of Fates at phone width: the header button covers the logo and squeezes the name out

source.ref: Seen while photographing the website editor for LIVE-2308 and LIVE-2309 (2026-11-16).

detail:
FINDING, filed 2026-11-16, not fixed. Reported as: on the House of Fates Space at 390 wide the mobile header overlaps the content beneath it. PREMISE RE-TESTED FIRST, and it is half right. The header does not sit on the page content. What collides is inside the header: its own button covers its own logo.

WHAT WAS MEASURED, in Chromium on the real components with the House of Fates content from lib/sites/house-of-fates-site.ts (Midnight theme, header button Book a free consultation). (1) The public Site, rendered by test/house-of-fates-site.render.test.tsx with HOF_SHOTS_DIR, at a 390 by 844 phone viewport: the header is sticky and in flow, it ends at 134px and the page content starts at 134px, so 0px of overlap at the top of the page on Home and on About; scrolled, it stays an opaque bar over the content, which is what a sticky header does. Inside the header the phone grid is two columns, the logo at minmax(0,1fr) and the actions at auto. The actions are 315px wide (a 255px button that cannot wrap, a 16px gap and the 44px menu button), which leaves the logo column 14.7px at 390 and 0px at 360. The 40px logo mark does not shrink, so 5px of it sits under the button at 390 and 20px at 360, and the Space name and tagline beside it are clipped to nothing at both widths. The logo column is 55px at 430 and 105px at 480, so the mark clears from about 420 up, but the name still has no room until much wider. (2) The website editor with the Phone device chosen (canvas document 375px wide, real WebsiteEditorShell and WebsiteCanvas over houseOfFatesEditorState): the same collision, logo column 0px, 18px of the mark under the button; the header ends 2px below the top of the first section; the first text of the page starts 226px below the header.

The offline render uses fallback faces, so the button width on a deploy will differ by a few pixels either way; the shape of the fault does not depend on the face, because the button is one unbreakable line of 24 letter-spaced capitals with 22px of padding each side. Any Midnight Site with a long header button has it; House of Fates is the one that shows it.

WHY IT IS NOT FIXED HERE. It is not a contained layout change through the kit or the shell. The header is the public Site theme (components/sites/midnight-css.ts over components/sites/house-css.ts and house-header.tsx), so any rule changes every Midnight Site, and which part yields at phone width is a design call: hide the header button on a phone and show it in the menu panel instead (the menu already receives it, but Midnight does not show it there), give Midnight the short phone label the Temple kit already has (hs-cta-short, which needs a short label from the Space's header button setting), or let the button shrink or wrap. Nothing was changed.

NOT VERIFIED: the live Site and the authenticated editor on a deploy with the real faces; Safari on a real phone; the Space profile page inside the member app (not rendered here; it wears the member shell, not this header). Pictures in the project files under editor/shell-night: hof-site-home-390-top, hof-site-home-390-scrolled, hof-site-about-390-top, hof-editor-1440-phone-device.

FIXED 2026-11-16 by the owner's ruling (Move the button into the menu): below 940px, where the menu button shows, components/sites/midnight-css.ts hides the header's own button and shows the menu's copy of it as a full-width Midnight button. The header keeps the logo mark and the Space name. One rule in the Midnight skin, so every Midnight Site with a long header button gets it; desktop is unchanged. Probe scripts/probes/midnight-phone-header-cta.mjs fails on the prior tree and passes here.
